steps.en: Install the launcher package, then fetch the browser
steps.zh: 装上启动库，再拉取浏览器

steps.en: Downloads the patched Firefox build paired with this launcher version, plus the fingerprint model
steps.zh: 下载与该启动库版本配对的补丁版 Firefox 和指纹模型

steps.en: Swap the browser launch line in your Playwright script; keep the rest
steps.zh: 把 Playwright 脚本里启动浏览器那一行换掉，其余不动

steps.en: Draws a device identity from real-traffic statistics and rejects impossible combinations
steps.zh: 按真实流量的统计分布抽一个设备身份，剔除不可能的组合

steps.en: Answers the page's fingerprint probes from native code and runs your Playwright calls out of the page's sight
steps.zh: 用原生代码回答指纹探测，在页面看不到的地方执行你的 Playwright 调用

value.en: Your existing Playwright script keeps its API while the browser underneath stops announcing itself as automated — no injected stealth scripts to maintain
value.zh: Playwright 脚本的 API 不变，浏览器不再自报是自动化——也不用再维护注入式 stealth 脚本

sources: pythonlib/README.md Installation (pip install -U camoufox[geoip]; camoufox fetch; fetch also installs fpgen's model pinned by sha256; 'Which browser build is used' — each release is paired with one browser build)
